challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Alex's attention and small treats toward several people make the similar behavior toward Jordan less distinctive, although repeated one-on-one plans with Jordan remain somewhat notable.

The absence of explicit romantic language, contact, or disclosure substantially limits confidence that Alex's interest is romantic, though Interpretation A also includes potentially romantic interest.
Postponing two dinners without proposing a concrete replacement during the following week weakens the case for active pursuit, although the stated reason was scheduling conflicts.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: The conclusion remains A by a narrow margin. MA-F1 through MA-F3 show repeated one-on-one initiative, individualized attention, and sustained private conversation about future activities. MA-F4 through MA-F6 provide meaningful friendly and non-romantic explanations, so confidence is reduced, but they do not make general friendliness clearly better supported.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Because the evidence only narrowly favors special or potentially romantic interest and contains no explicit romantic signal, low-pressure direct clarification is more reliable than further inference.
